title: GATE context labels for EdgeLab events
description: Point-in-time regime labels joined at event t0 only. No outcomes. Fail-closed.

required_event_input_columns.event_id: string — unique id of TRAP/zone/fill event from NT8 export
required_event_input_columns.t0: datetime64[ns, UTC] or epoch_ns — start of event/bucket (decision time)
required_event_input_columns.t1: datetime64[ns, UTC] or epoch_ns — optional end; never used for features
required_event_input_columns.session_id: string — CME trade_date or session key
required_event_input_columns.ancho_ticks: float — optional; needed for target-free corr diagnostic (Paso 2)

label_output_columns.sticky_age_bars: int32 — bars since last regime change at t0
label_output_columns.as_of_ok: bool — true only if all features available at t0

join_rules.missing_policy: fail-closed: as_of_ok=false, regime unset or NaN
